name: Rosti North Carolina
old_description: Partner in Precision Plastic Injection Moulding and Contract Manufacturing
about:
Rosti North Carolina operates from Cary, North Carolina, as part of the Rosti Group, a global plastic injection moulding and contract manufacturing company founded in 1944. The group has grown to 13 manufacturing sites across Europe, Asia, and North America, with the North Carolina location serving as a strategic hub for the Americas.

The facility provides precision plastic injection moulding, including multi-material moulding, high-volume production, and complex geometry capabilities. It also offers ISO-classified cleanroom manufacturing for medical devices, pharmaceuticals, and diagnostics, along with integrated automation and assembly, robotic handling, automated inspection, and toolmaking with rapid sampling and pilot production. The company emphasizes scalable production models that span from early prototypes to multi-site, full-scale manufacturing.

Rosti serves OEMs in medical and life sciences, automotive and e-mobility, consumer and home appliances, industrial and professional equipment, and filtration, optics, and high-performance components. Its cleanroom capabilities and ISO 13485 certification make it a partner for regulated medical and diagnostic production.

The company differentiates itself through over 80 years of manufacturing heritage, a global footprint, and sustainability commitments that include 100 percent clean energy at all sites, a 2030 emissions reduction roadmap, and circular design principles. An on-site Innovation & Sustainability Centre supports material optimization and energy-efficient tooling.
